lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular clusters is visible posterior to the gills. The centroids are arranged in approximately four to five horizontal rows, with increased spacing between nodes as they progress toward the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are clearly visible, intersecting the horizontal rows of blobs to form a distinctive rectangular grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges are visible along the upper flank. The primary lateral ridge displays a sharp luminance gradient, characterized by a bright upper edge and a distinct shadow-cast gradient immediately below, running from the mid-body to the tail.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Small, lower-intensity white blobs are sparsely distributed within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, primarily concentrated along the lower half and the leading edge of the fin surface.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple elongated, low-luminance silhouettes (commensal fish) are visible attached to or swimming in close proximity to the ventral surface and the trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
